Chicken soup powder.
Feb 2026 • Family
There was an error in business hours.
Probably because it's New Year's Eve.
When I went there, the market didn't open until 5 p.m.
It's not clear if you can drive it on New Year's Eve.
Ordered a chicken hashish that's only available at the late market.
And chicken wings, chicken thigh powder and a whole chicken thigh 🍗
It's a bit scary that this portion is true.
How big is this chicken? [Hushes face] It's very tight, it's a little chai on its own.
No wonder soup has to go with it.
Dry fishing with a little bit of sweetness, the powder will be drier and more resilient.
Chicken will taste better with soup powder. Powder and chicken will taste better when inhaled.

At a price of 190,000 a chicken leg, it's a lot cheaper than powder.

The best pho in Hanoi
Aug 2024 • Couples
We ate here on our first night in Vietnam and then again 3 weeks later on our penultimate night, it was that good. 

They do the dry and the soupy pho, you pick the type of chicken you want (I recommend the thigh & breast combo) and then whether you want it dry or as soup. Both are amazing. The dry one is Hanoi speciality and comes with a small bowl of the broth. Definitely get the fried beef sticks too (they are 10k VND). The chilli sauce and pickled garlic on the tables are great accompaniments. 

Meal & drinks for two people for around £6. Amazing!
